programs.title: Ramji Londonwaley
programs.desc: Ramji, a docile cook from a small Indian town, arrives in London for work only to find out that his employer is dead. He is further saddled with immigration issues that force him to marry.

programs.title: Ek Ajnabee
programs.desc: A supernatural thriller that tells the story of a magician haunted by a childhood memory of encountering a witch. When he falls in love with a woman who resembles the witch, he must confront his fears and uncover the truth about her identity. The film explores themes of superstition, fear, and the power of the mind in a spine-tingling and suspenseful plot.

programs.title: Pyare Mohan
programs.desc: A blind man Pyare and his deaf friend Mohan fall in love with twin sisters Preeti and Priya. But their relationships spiral into chaos when the sisters get falsely implicated in a murder case and the men have to find a way to save them.

programs.title: I, Me Aur Main
programs.desc: Aarush, Al and Tanmay, three womanisers get the shock of their life when they find a baby girl at their doorstep claiming to be the daughter of one of them. As they try to find her mother, they discover an unexplored side of their own personality.
